title: Arrival parity pass 6: the grid misses buildings over 40 m (TallSolid); MechAI goto stutter

facts.title: Collider faces are one-sided: a ray starting inside a building sees none of it
facts.fact: The game's collision ray query (sub_A10A0 + sub_8DF50) only hits faces seen from outside, and the terrain is not in that space. The bot grid probe cast down from ground+40 m, so any building taller than 40 m was open ground. Rush Hour has 4562 such cells (2 m grid); its 42-50 m block at 1118-1138,1322-1344 read as a 20 m corridor between two 7-9 m walls, and team 2 'Mechs stood 25-30 s at its face (Z_85a/b). FPROBE on D_85b1: a down ray from +100 m hits the roof at +42/+50, an up ray from +0.5 m hits nothing. TallSolid (commit adbf1ec): the first ray starts at terrain top + 160 m; if it meets something above ground+40, the 44 m ray gives the surface below and an up ray from that surface separates an overhead deck (underside hit: the low surface stays) from a solid (no hit: the roof is the surface). Movers, projectiles and water above keep the old ray.
facts.how_to_use: [C7] tallsolid cells/open; RECOMP_BOT_DIAG prints [BOT-NAV] tallsolid. RECOMP_BOT_TALL_SOLID=0 / [Bots] TallSolid=0 = old. RECOMP_BOT_FPROBE now also logs top (down from +100 m) and up rays per point; RECOMP_BOT_STALLPROBE=1 logs rays from stalled bot 'Mechs.

facts.title: The campaign MechAI goto can stutter (0.3 s step, 0.8 s stop) while facing its carrot
facts.fact: Q_81a1 b6 (Ill Wind Snatch It, team 2) right after boarding, 10.1-14.6 s at 1199-1188,1419-1421: drive A348 (body_steer to MechAI mode 6), yaw equal to the carrot bearing, yet it moves in 0.3 s bursts and stands 0.8-1 s between them (about 1 m/s in all). Each burst moves more than 0.7 m, which resets GotoWalk's 1 s still-timer, so walk-direct (W3515) only took over at 14.6 s; then 12-24 m/s. Nobody within 15 m (no crowding). This is ~3-4 s of team 2's post-boarding loss. Not fixed: a fix would judge progress over a 2 s window instead of a 1 s still-timer.
